memory_candidates.content: CSLib has a CI pipeline gap: `lake lint` (environment linters) only runs in a weekly cron, not in PR CI. The 7 linter categories are: docBlame, defLemma, defsWithUnderscore, simpNF, unusedSectionVars, topNamespace, dupNamespace. Agent enforcement via lint-prevention-rules.md prevents silent accumulation (tasks 208-213 fixed 850+ errors). Grep: `lake lint 2>&1 | grep -E 'docBlame|defLemma|defsWithUnderscore|simpNF|unusedSectionVars|topNamespace|dupNamespace'`
